verdict.rationale: Raygun documents stack-trace fingerprinting grouping by exception type, class name, method name, and stack trace location [raygun-docs-7], which covers the core deduplication claim. However, there is no evidence of a mechanism to customize or override grouping when it misfires (e.g., manual merge/split of error groups); only unrelated workflow controls like ignore rules and resolved statuses are documented [raygun-docs-11][raygun-docs-26][raygun-docs-10]. Missing for 10: documented ability to manually re-group, split, or merge error groups when fingerprinting is wrong, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of grouping accuracy or customization.
